name: Nutanix API Patterns
description: Nutanix MCP fundamentals: the discovery-driven tool surface (4 discovery tools plus one `<namespace>_execute` tool per v4 API namespace — not per-entity CRUD tools), the listOperations → getOperationSchema → execute workflow, Conduit gateway credential configuration for Prism Central, OData query parameters, the read-only enforcement mode, and namespace availability rules.
